entries.name: TRELLO_API_KEY
entries.description: The API key of a Trello Power-Up made for KaratOS. On its own it reads nothing, but it is kept with the token.
howToGet: Signed in to Trello as the client's admin, open the Power-Up admin portal (trello.com/power-ups/admin), create a Power-Up named KaratOS in the client's workspace, and open its API key tab.
Generate a new API key and copy it straight into the host's secret store.

entries.name: TRELLO_TOKEN
entries.description: A Trello token authorized with scope=read only, for the member whose boards are read. The connector asks Trello what the token may do before every sync and stops if it can write.
howToGet: As a member who can see the boards to sync and no more, open https://trello.com/1/authorize?expiration=never&scope=read&response_type=token&name=KaratOS&key= followed by TRELLO_API_KEY.
Check the page says KaratOS will be able to read, and nothing more, then allow it.
Copy the token straight into the host's secret store. Never paste it into chat or an issue.
